C-604/22 dated 7 March 2024.

checked.claim: Decision 79/2025 dated May 2025; Market Court referred 13 questions, announced 4 Dec 2025
checked.evidence: DPA news page refused WebFetch (robots.txt timeout). Secondary sources: decision 79/2025 of 24 April 2025 (published around 13 May 2025) gave FPS Finance until 24 April 2026; reprimand and compliance order, no fine as public bodies are exempt; Belgian State appealed; Market Court interlocutory judgment of 26 November 2025 referred 13 questions, now CJEU C-804/25. The date in the file is the publication month, not the decision date.
checked.replacement: Decision 79/2025 (24 April 2025), on a complaint by the Belgian Accidental Americans Association and a member, found FATCA bank-data transfers to the US unlawful and ordered corrective measures within a year; no fine because of Art. 221 § 2. On appeal by the Belgian State, the Market Court referred 13 questions to the CJEU (judgment of 26 Nov 2025, announced 4 Dec 2025; C-804/25).

checked.claim: 30 days from notification; third parties 30 days from publication
checked.evidence: Art. 108: 30 days from notification; third parties with direct, personal and legitimate interest 30 days from publication on the website.

checked.claim: Not suspensive; exception for deletion orders
checked.evidence: Art. 108 § 1: decisions are provisionally enforceable except erasure orders, and the chamber may decide otherwise by specially reasoned decision. The second exception is missing.
checked.replacement: No. Decisions are provisionally enforceable notwithstanding appeal, except deletion orders or where the Litigation Chamber decides otherwise in a specially reasoned decision (Art. 108 § 1 LCA).

checked.evidence: Art. 105: facts time-barred five years after commission; investigation or prosecution acts interrupt and restart the period.
